data.title: Smart Manufacturing
data.tagline: Traceability, OEE, and quality intelligence built on the plant floor.
data.overview: We turn production data into operating decisions. Our teams connect machines, quality systems, and people with a data model that reflects how the plant actually runs — then prove the value on one line before scaling.

problems.title: OEE calculated by spreadsheet
problems.description: Performance is reviewed weekly, after the losses have already happened.

problems.title: Quality data disconnected
problems.description: Inspection results sit apart from process parameters, so root cause takes days.

problems.title: Reactive maintenance
problems.description: Assets are serviced on calendar intervals rather than condition and criticality.

approach.title: Value-stream diagnostic
approach.description: Identify the two or three losses worth instrumenting first.

approach.title: Operating data model
approach.description: Define assets, shifts, products, and quality events once, consistently.

approach.title: Edge connectivity
approach.description: Collect signals safely without exposing control networks to the enterprise.

approach.title: Adoption on the floor
approach.description: Design screens and routines for supervisors, not only for analysts.

capabilities.title: OEE and downtime intelligence
capabilities.description: Reason-coded stops, shift reporting, and loss trees operators trust.

capabilities.title: Traceability
capabilities.description: Batch, component, and process genealogy across lines and suppliers.

capabilities.title: Quality analytics
capabilities.description: SPC, defect correlation, and closed-loop corrective actions.

capabilities.title: Energy and utilities monitoring
capabilities.description: Consumption per product and per shift with actionable anomalies.

benefits.title: Losses visible within a shift
benefits.description: Supervisors act while the cause is still recoverable.

benefits.title: Faster root-cause analysis
benefits.description: Process and quality context in one timeline.

benefits.title: Better capacity decisions
benefits.description: Actual constraint data instead of estimates.

benefits.title: Scalable foundation
benefits.description: A repeatable model for the next line and the next site.
